name: Parallel USDp
oneLiner: USDp is Parallel's DAO-governed dollar minted against a whitelisted basket of overcollateralized stablecoins through a licensed Angle Transmuter fork.
collateral: Overcollateralized basket of correlated USD stablecoins and yield-bearing wrappers routed through the Parallelizer Module: frxUSD, sfrxUSD, USDe, sUSDe on Ethereum; USDS, sUSDS on Base; USDe, sUSDe on HyperEVM; USDC and ygamiUSDC on Avalanche. Composition and exposure limits set by sPRL holders via DAO vote.
pegMechanism: Parallelizer Module (a licensed fork of Angle Protocol's Transmuter) lets users mint and burn USDp at oracle value against a whitelisted overcollateralized basket, with adaptive fees that widen on depeg. Yield is delivered through a separate Savings Module wrapper (sUSDp); liquid USDp itself does not accrue yield.

oracleRisk.summary: Parallel USDp prices backing assets with Chainlink, RedStone, DIA fundamental feeds, exchange-rate feeds, and per-asset stale periods, without documented failover.

branchApplicability.rationale: Parallel USDp is minted, burned, and redeemed through the Parallelizer Module against a DAO-whitelisted basket priced at oracle value. The reviewed implementation exposes no borrower-specific debt positions, collateral health checks, or liquidation engine for USDp holders; asset depeg handling uses adaptive mint/burn fees and proportional redemption instead of CDP liquidation branches.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Parallel USDp is issuer-native on every observed chain: each deployment's authority() returns a chain-local ParallelAccessManager mint-authority module operated by the Parallel DAO/team, so Pharos scores the reviewed routes as issuer-native burn/mint with no external bridge protocol carrying the claim.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20)

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current dated reserve inventory links USDp exposure to multiple separately tracked upstream stablecoins and wrapper assets. This is an inherited upstream-access posture, not a claim that the USDp contracts themselves expose a direct holder blacklist or freeze function.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The 2026-07-14 reserve review identifies frxUSD, sfrxUSD, USDe, sUSDe, sUSDS, USDS, and USDC exposure. USDp's access posture therefore remains inherited from upstream reserve and custody controls; no direct USDp holder restriction is asserted by this review.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG-2 Safety Score V9 access review

notices.title: Not the cemetery PAR or Paxos USDP
notices.message: Parallel USDp (llamaId 291, Parallel V3) is distinct from the abandoned Mimo Labs PAR (Euro CDP, llamaId 56) and from Paxos USDP / PAX Dollar. The Parallelizer is a licensed fork of Angle Protocol's Transmuter; Mimo Labs and Cooper Labs hold commercial use rights to the codebase.

reserveReview.rationale: Parallel's server-rendered transparency inventory publishes each current reserve asset and USD value across Ethereum, HyperEVM, Base, and Avalanche. The ygamiUSDC ERC-4626 contract returns Avalanche USDC from asset(), so both direct USDC and vault-share exposure map exactly to USDC without collapsing the vault's strategy risk.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current USD values from Parallel's official transparency inventory, aggregated by reserve token and normalized to the published total
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified reserve assets in the published inventory; ygamiUSDC remains separately labeled and risk-rated while its USDC underlying creates the dependency edge.

mintAuthority.summary: USDp's Ethereum Parallelizer diamond mints and burns against a governed collateral basket under a 5/8 Safe-controlled AccessManager. The 22 non-Ethereum deployments share four AccessManagers whose terminal administrator is the same 5/8 Parallel team signer set on 20 chains; Sei and Fraxtal remain unidentified.

controls.label: Parallelizer module (Angle Transmuter fork, diamond proxy)
controls.capDescription: Mint at oracle value against the whitelisted basket, bounded by per-asset exposure limits and adaptive fees that widen on depeg; redemption is proportional across the basket.
controls.evidence: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: the Parallelizer diamond proxy 0x6efeddf9269c3683ba516cb0e2124fe335f262a2 received USDp minter role 110 in ParallelAccessManager via a RoleGranted event at Ethereum block 22815811 and hasRole(110, diamond) = true; facetAddresses() returns the Transmuter-fork facet set and getCollateralList() returns the governed basket [frxUSD, sfrxUSD, USDS, USD0].

controls.label: Parallel team Safe 5/8 (ParallelAccessManager ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20 at Ethereum block 25573468: hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE=0, Safe 0x25Fc7ffa8f9da3582a36633d04804F0004706F9b) = true on ParallelAccessManager 0x94Ea8800444017695345156319e96bdB1E355F7a; Safe getOwners() returned 8 and getThreshold() returned 5. The ADMIN_ROLE holder grants and revokes minter role 110, which gates mint(address,uint256) on the USDp token. accessManager() on the Parallelizer diamond returns this manager, getTargetFunctionRole(diamond, diamondCut=0x1f931c1c) = 10, and canCall(Safe, diamond, diamondCut) = true, so the Safe can change diamond facets and mint-critical module logic without a configured target delay.

controls.label: Parallel team Safe 5/8 (non-Ethereum ParallelAccessManager ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20. USDp.authority() resolves to only four distinct non-Ethereum ParallelAccessManagers: 0x0e4e7ca9d7b1e6293d0713efefb4bca010debf46 (Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet), 0xfd28f108e95f4d41daae9dbfff707d677985998e (17 chains), 0x8efb3ded78fbaef2a4efe01e01bbd911e4094b78 (Sonic) and 0x7df74bbb6f82ec1bcb1562a30ef5bf5c326e2811 (Polygon); on every one of them getTargetFunctionRole(USDp, mint(address,uint256)) = role 110 and getRoleAdmin(110) = role 10. hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE=0, 0xc5201ffe258a95af986e7cd1fcad54f3f63f2c95) and hasRole(10, same) are both true on Base (block 48888065), Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Avalanche, Sonic, Scroll, Ink, World Chain, BNB Chain, X Layer, Berachain, Gnosis, Unichain, Linea, Plasma, Katana, Hemi and HyperEVM. Polygon uses Safe 0x2046c0416a558c40cb112e5ebb0ca764c3c5c32a and Plume uses Safe 0xd22b9e8ee5b6490c667d90c6819e53e9503ee139; owner-linked-list walks from Safe storage slot 2 show all three Safes carry the identical eight signers and threshold 5 as the Ethereum team Safe. Safe state read from storage on Base: ownerCount 8, threshold 5, Safe 1.4.1 singleton 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762, module list sentinel-only, guard 0x0. The original deployer EOA 0x66ccec236bbce5f1bbd1b2fc0a4014e57a55ad02 was granted ADMIN_ROLE at deployment and no longer holds it on Base or OP Mainnet.

review.evidence: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: Ethereum USDp authority() = ParallelAccessManager 0x94Ea8800444017695345156319e96bdB1E355F7a; the Parallelizer diamond holds its minter role and the 5/8 team Safe holds ADMIN_ROLE and can diamondCut its mint-critical module logic. The non-Ethereum route inventory was enumerated on 2026-07-20: all 22 non-Ethereum deployments resolve to just four AccessManagers, each gating mint(address,uint256) behind role 110 with role 10 as its role admin, and on 20 of the 22 chains the terminal ADMIN_ROLE holder is a Parallel team 5/8 Safe carrying the same eight signers as the Ethereum Safe (0xc5201ffe... on 18 chains, 0x2046c041... on Polygon, 0xd22b9e8e... on Plume). Role-110 membership is chain-specific rather than shared: on Base four contracts hold it (0x08417cdb, 0xc3bef21e, 0x472ed57b, 0x4dde0e30) while the same manager grants none of them on OP Mainnet. The terminal administrator on Sei and Fraxtal could not be enumerated because no archive log range or Blockscout logs endpoint was reachable for those two chains, and none of the three known Parallel Safes or the deployer EOA holds ADMIN_ROLE there, so the asset-wide review stays unresolved.
review.reviewer: P2 mint-free cohort; V9 Phase 3 curation lane cur-3 (2026-07-20)
unresolvedQuestions: Identify the terminal ADMIN_ROLE holder of ParallelAccessManager 0xfd28f108e95f4d41daae9dbfff707d677985998e on Sei and Fraxtal; the three known Parallel team 5/8 Safes and the deployer EOA all return hasRole(0, account) = false on both chains, so the mint-grant authority for those two deployments is unidentified.
